messages.subject: Switching between plot and plotly
parts:
I want to write a modular shiny app that displays both ggplots and plotly plots.

Here is the main script that handles the different modules:

# Load all of the modules
for (c in choices){
  source(paste(c, '.R', sep=''))
}

choosePlotInput <- function(id, label = "Choose Plot", ...) {
  # Create a namespace function using the provided id
  ns <- NS(id)
  
  tagList(
    selectInput(ns("choice"), "Choose Visualization", choices, ...),
    uiOutput(ns("plot_controls"))
  )
}

choosePlotOutput <- function(id, label = "Choose Plot"){
  ns <- NS(id)
  
  fluidRow(
    column(9, plotOutput(ns("mainplot"))),
    column(3, plotOutput(ns("sideplot")))
  )
  
}

# Module server function
choosePlot <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$plot_controls <- renderUI({
    eval(parse(text=paste(input$choice, 'Controls(session$ns, omicsData)', sep='')))
  })
  
  output$mainplot <- renderPlot({
    eval(parse(text=paste(input$choice, 'MainPlot(input, omicsData)', sep='')))
  })
  
  output$sideplot <- renderPlot({
    eval(parse(text=paste(input$choice, 'SidePlot(input, omicsData)', sep='')))
  })
  
  return(1)
}

Right now, it is only able to plot a normal plot (using plotOutput() and renderPlot()).

I would like to know a way to plot either a plot or a plotly in these three panels, depending on the output of selected modules 'MainPlot' and 'SidePlot' functions.

I apologize if this is unclear, happy to clarify if necessary.

- Matt Durrant

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Switching between plot and plotly
parts:
Absolutely do not use eval/parse blindly on user input! Those values come directly from the web browser and cannot be trusted!

I would define outputs on the server for all the possible plot types you want to support. But don't include any of the outputs directly in the UI. Instead use a uiOutput/renderUI, where the renderUI returns the appropriate plotOutput, plotlyOutput, etc. as appropriate.
